title: Improve Imagen Campaign Output Quality
description: Improve AI-generated marketing visuals by simplifying prompts, focusing subject clarity, and iterating one descriptor at a time.
prerequisites: You can access the AI Image Generator.
You know the campaign objective and target visual style.
You have a baseline prompt and at least one output to evaluate.
steps: Start with a single clear subject and avoid crowded scene instructions.
Add style and rendering descriptors deliberately, such as minimalist, macro, or cinematic lighting.
Generate an initial image and assess composition, subject clarity, and brand fit.
Modify one prompt descriptor at a time instead of rewriting the entire prompt between attempts.
Repeat short iterations until output quality stabilizes around campaign requirements.
Save the winning prompt and image variant for reproducibility and team reuse.
validations: Output has one clear focal subject aligned to campaign intent.
Image style, texture, and lighting reflect requested visual direction.
Prompt changes produce predictable incremental output differences.
commonErrors: Prompt includes too many competing subjects and creates cluttered output.
Large prompt rewrites make iteration results unpredictable.
Style terms conflict and degrade image consistency.
recovery: Reduce prompt to one subject and two or three style constraints.
Reintroduce descriptors one at a time and compare outputs.
Store successful prompt variants as reusable templates.

faq.question: How specific should my prompt be?
faq.answer: Be specific about subject and style, but avoid overloading the prompt with many unrelated scene elements.

faq.question: Why change one word at a time?
faq.answer: Single-variable iteration helps isolate which descriptor improved or degraded output quality.
